propositions: A focused prerequisite-consistency Pass-1 finder must receive stable batched prerequisite blocks from a preloaded relation snapshot, evaluate each independently against the subject plan, and emit exactly one disposition (consistent/finding/indeterminate) per readable pinned ID without cross-prerequisite comparisons.

Every focused finding must carry the authoritative prerequisite ID, be verified only against that exact prerequisite block's plan, and be rejected as invalid if attribution cannot be proven; missing or incorrect attribution must prevent any finding from becoming a blocker.

Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record must force the terminal verdict to unsigned INDETERMINATE while preserving all DET blockers visibly in the blocking array and setting the prerequisite_indeterminate flag for coach input.

Focused finder and verifier bins must preserve whole PrerequisiteBlock objects and whole subject-plan text during context-limit splits; a singleton oversized finding tuple may be split, but neither plan is ever fragmented.
General and focused Pass-2 verification must use separate non-overlapping index domains; both domains must be reshaped independently before concatenation so neither can shift the other's indices.

A singleton prerequisite-finder evaluation must achieve recall ≥0.90, false-acceptance ≤0.10, coverage completeness =1.00, and attribution-error rate =0.00 before packed evaluation; packed results must show no regression against the pinned singleton metrics while meeting the same absolute floors.
